sentences.text: Hannah and Her Sisters is a 1986 American comedy-drama film which tells the intertwined stories of an extended family over two years that begins and ends with a family Thanksgiving dinner .	comedy-drama film	comedy-drama	Thanksgiving dinner	Thanksgiving#Thanksgiving dinner

The film was written and directed by Woody Allen , who stars along with Mia Farrow as Hannah , Michael Caine as her husband , and Barbara Hershey and Dianne Wiest as her sisters .	Woody Allen	Woody Allen	Michael Caine	Michael Caine	Mia Farrow	Mia Farrow	Barbara Hershey	Barbara Hershey	Dianne Wiest	Dianne Wiest

The film 's ensemble cast also includes Carrie Fisher , Farrow 's mother Maureen O'Sullivan , Lloyd Nolan -LRB- who died in September 1985 , more than four months before the film 's release -RRB- , Max von Sydow and Julie Kavner .	Carrie Fisher	Carrie Fisher	Lloyd Nolan	Lloyd Nolan	Maureen O'Sullivan	Maureen O'Sullivan	Max von Sydow	Max von Sydow	Julie Kavner	Julie Kavner

Daniel Stern , Richard Jenkins , Fred Melamed , Lewis Black , Joanna Gleason , John Turturro , and Julia Louis-Dreyfus all have minor roles , while Tony Roberts and Sam Waterston make uncredited cameo appearances .	Daniel Stern	Daniel Stern (actor)	Richard Jenkins	Richard Jenkins	Fred Melamed	Fred Melamed	Lewis Black	Lewis Black	Joanna Gleason	Joanna Gleason	John Turturro	John Turturro	Julia Louis-Dreyfus	Julia Louis-Dreyfus	Tony Roberts	Tony Roberts (actor)	Sam Waterston	Sam Waterston

Several of Farrow 's children , including a pre-adolescent Soon-Yi Previn -LRB- who married Allen in 1997 -RRB- , have credited and uncredited roles , mostly as Thanksgiving extras .	Soon-Yi Previn	Soon-Yi Previn	extras	Extra (actor)
Hannah and Her Sisters was for a long time Allen 's biggest box office hit -LRB- forgoing adjustment for inflation -RRB- , with a North American gross of US$ 40 million .

The film won Academy Awards for Best Original Screenplay , Best Supporting Actor , and Best Supporting Actress .	Best Original Screenplay	Best Original Screenplay	Best Supporting Actor	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor	Best Supporting Actress	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress
It is often considered one of Allen 's major works , with critics continuing to praise its writing and ensemble cast .
